macros.name: boolConst
macros.doc: Creates a new constant ⟨boolean⟩ or raises an error if the name is already taken.

macros.name: boolIfExistF
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨boolean⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: boolIfExistT
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨boolean⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: boolIfExistTF
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨boolean⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: boolNew
macros.doc: Creates a new ⟨boolean⟩ or raises an error if the name is already taken.

macros.name: boolSetFalse
macros.doc: Sets ⟨boolean⟩ logically false.

macros.name: boolSetTrue
macros.doc: Sets ⟨boolean⟩ logically true.

macros.name: boolVarDoUntil
macros.doc: Places the ⟨code⟩ in the input stream for TeX to process, and then checks the logical value of the ⟨boolean⟩. If it is false then the ⟨code⟩ is inserted into the input stream again and the process loops until the ⟨boolean⟩ is true.

macros.name: boolVarDoWhile
macros.doc: Places the ⟨code⟩ in the input stream for TeX to process, and then checks the logical value of the ⟨boolean⟩. If it is true then the ⟨code⟩ is inserted into the input stream again and the process loops until the ⟨boolean⟩ is false.

macros.name: boolVarIfF
macros.doc: Tests the current truth of ⟨boolean⟩, and continues evaluation based on this result.

macros.name: boolVarIfT
macros.doc: Tests the current truth of ⟨boolean⟩, and continues evaluation based on this result.

macros.name: boolVarIfTF
macros.doc: Tests the current truth of ⟨boolean⟩, and continues evaluation based on this result.

macros.name: boolVarLog
macros.doc: Writes the logical truth of the ⟨boolean⟩ in the log file.

macros.name: boolVarShow
macros.doc: Displays the logical truth of the ⟨boolean⟩ on the terminal.

macros.name: charFoldcase

The case mapping is carried out with no context-dependence (cf. \textUppercase, etc.) These functions generate characters with the category code of the ⟨char⟩ (i.e. only the character code changes).

macros.name: clistVarReverse

macros.name: onlyName
macros.doc: Expands the ⟨tokens⟩ until only characters remain, and then converts this into a control sequence.

macros.name: prgDo
macros.doc: Treats ⟨code⟩ as an anonymous function without arguments and evaluates it.

macros.name: prgNewConditional
macros.doc: Creates protected conditional ⟨function⟩ for evaluating the ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: prgNewFunction
macros.doc: Creates protected ⟨function⟩ for evaluating the ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: prgPrint
macros.doc: Prints ⟨tokens⟩ directly to the input stream.

macros.name: prgReturn
macros.doc: Returns ⟨tokens⟩ as result of current function or conditional.

macros.name: qNoValue
macros.doc: A canonical value for a missing value, when one is requested from a data structure.

macros.name: quarkVarIfNoValueF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨token⟩ is equal to \qNoValue.

macros.name: quarkVarIfNoValueT
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨token⟩ is equal to \qNoValue.

macros.name: quarkVarIfNoValueTF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨token⟩ is equal to \qNoValue.

macros.name: regexMatchF
macros.doc: Tests whether the hregular expressioni matches any part of the htoken listi.

macros.name: seqClear
macros.doc: Clears all items from the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqClearNew
macros.doc: Ensures that the ⟨sequence⟩ exists globally by applying \seqNew if necessary, then applies \seqClear to leave the ⟨sequence⟩ empty.

macros.name: seqIfExistF
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨sequence⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: seqIfExistT
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨sequence⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: seqIfExistTF
macros.doc: Tests whether the ⟨sequence⟩ is currently defined.

macros.name: seqNew
macros.doc: Creates a new ⟨sequence⟩ or raises an error if the name is already taken.

macros.name: seqPush
macros.doc: Adds the {⟨item⟩} to the top of the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqPutLeft
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨item⟩ to the left of the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqPutRight
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨item⟩ to the right of the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarIfEmptyF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨sequence⟩ is empty (containing no items).

macros.name: seqVarIfEmptyT
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨sequence⟩ is empty (containing no items).

macros.name: seqVarIfEmptyTF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨sequence⟩ is empty (containing no items).

macros.name: seqVarIfInF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨item⟩ is present in the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarIfInT
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨item⟩ is present in the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarIfInTF
macros.doc: Tests if the ⟨item⟩ is present in the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarLog
macros.doc: Writes the entries in the ⟨sequence⟩ in the log file.

macros.name: seqVarMapVariable
macros.doc: \seqVarMapVariable ⟨sequence⟩ ⟨variable⟩ {⟨code⟩} Stores each ⟨item⟩ of the ⟨sequence⟩ in turn in the (token list) ⟨variable⟩ and applies the ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: seqVarRemoveAll
macros.doc: Removes every occurrence of ⟨item⟩ from the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarRemoveDuplicates
macros.doc: Removes duplicate items from the ⟨sequence⟩, leaving the left most copy of each item in the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarReverse
macros.doc: Reverses the order of the items stored in the ⟨sequence⟩.

macros.name: seqVarShow
macros.doc: Displays the entries in the ⟨sequence⟩ in the terminal.

macros.name: strCount
macros.doc: Returns the number of characters in the string representation of htoken listi, as an integer denotation.

macros.name: strIfEqT
macros.doc: Compares the two htoken listsi on a character by character basis (namely after converting them to strings), and is true if the two ⟨strings⟩ contain the same characters in the same order.

macros.name: strIfInF
macros.doc: Converts both htoken listsi to ⟨strings⟩ and tests whether hstring2 i is found inside hstring1 i.

macros.name: strIfInTF
macros.doc: Converts both htoken listsi to ⟨strings⟩ and tests whether hstring2 i is found inside hstring1 i.

macros.name: strItem
macros.doc: Converts the htoken listi to a ⟨string⟩, and returns the character in position hinteger expressioni of the ⟨string⟩, starting at 1 for the first (left-most) character.

macros.name: textExpand
macros.doc: Takes user input ⟨text⟩ and expands the content.

macros.name: textLangTitlecase
macros.doc: Takes user input ⟨text⟩ first applies \textExpand, then transforms the case of character tokens as specified by the function name.

macros.name: textLangTitlecaseFirst
macros.doc: Takes user input ⟨text⟩ first applies \textExpand, then transforms the case of character tokens as specified by the function name.

macros.name: textLangUppercase
macros.doc: Takes user input ⟨text⟩ first applies \textExpand, then transforms the case of character tokens as specified by the function name.

macros.name: textTitlecase
macros.doc: The function \textTitlecase applies (broadly) uppercasing to the first letter of the input, then lowercasing to the remainder.

macros.name: textTitlecaseFirst
macros.doc: Takes user input ⟨text⟩ first applies \textExpand, then transforms the case of character tokens as specified by the function name.

macros.name: tlCount
macros.doc: Counts the number of ⟨items⟩ in ⟨tokens⟩ and returns this information.

macros.name: tlHead
macros.doc: Returns the first ⟨item⟩ in the htoken listi, discarding the rest of the htoken listi.

macros.name: tlIfBlankF
macros.doc: Tests if the htoken listi consists only of blank spaces (i.e. contains no item).

macros.name: tlIfEmptyT
macros.doc: Tests if the htoken listi is entirely empty (i.e. contains no tokens at all).

macros.name: tlIfEqF
macros.doc: Tests if htoken list1 i and htoken list2 i contain the same list of tokens, both in respect of character codes and category codes.

macros.name: tlMapVariable
macros.doc: Stores each ⟨item⟩ of the htoken listi in turn in the (token list) ⟨variable⟩ and applies the ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: unExpand
macros.doc: Prevents expansion of the ⟨tokens⟩ inside the argument of \expWhole function.

macros.name: useGobble
macros.doc: The function \useGobble discards the second argument, and returns the content of the first argument.

macros.name: useOne
macros.doc: The function \useOne absorbs one argument and returns it.
